title: boltons: Bug report (issue #469) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is boltons (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #469) from a user of this library:

> `boltons.timeutils.relative_time(d)` and `decimal_relative_time(d)` fail for timezone-aware datetimes when you don't pass `other`: `relative_time(datetime.now(timezone.utc))` raises instead of returning `'0 seconds ago'`. Naive datetimes work. The default comparison time should match the timezone (or lack of one) of the datetime passed in.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
